overview.title: بوابة إلى المدينة المحصّنة
overview.p1: باب القصبة من أشهر فتحات أسوار تارودانت. الأبراج الطينية والقوس يؤطران الانتقال بين الطرق الخارجية والأزقة الداخلية.
overview.p2: توقف قصير في مشي الأسوار أو نقطة لقاء قبل استكشاف المدينة. اجمعه مع أسراك والسوق في نصف يوم.

1.title: Soft morning brick
1.desc: Good light and cooler air for photos at the gate.

2.desc: Still photogenic, but heat builds quickly in the open.

3.title: Warm evening tone
3.desc: Ochre walls take on the classic Taroudant glow.

food.title: الأكل في المنطقة
food.p1: Limited right at the gate. Walk toward Assarag or the medina for cafés and restaurants.
food.p2: Treat the gate as a photo and orientation stop.
food.li5: Hotel dining if you prefer convenience.

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: Short walk or petit taxi from Assarag depending on your starting point.

2.title: Photos
2.desc: Step back from the arch for the full tower composition; watch for traffic.

3.title: Combine
3.desc: Natural link with a longer ramparts segment and the souks.

q1.question: Is Bab El Kasbah the only gate?
q1.answer: No — Taroudant has several gates; this is among the most visited.

q2.question: Climb the gate?
q2.answer: Generally admire from ground level; access rules can vary.

q3.question: Time needed?
q3.answer: Twenty to forty-five minutes including photos.

q4.question: Good at night?
q4.answer: Early evening is fine; full night walks are less common for visitors.

q5.question: Nearby parking?
q5.answer: Ask locally; centre access can be tight for cars.
